unit: Laboratory for Innovation Science at Harvard (Harvard HBS)

labs.lab_name: Laboratory for Innovation Science at Harvard
labs.location: 6th floor, HBS AI Institute, Harvard John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences, 150 Western Ave
labs.research_summary: Lab inside the HBS AI Institute that runs field experiments and research on how AI and digital technology change innovation, decision-making and business.
labs.member_breakdown: 2 leadership (co-chair/PI and founding chair of the AI Institute), 8 faculty and other principal investigators, 14 core lab (postdoctoral fellows, research associates, a senior research scientist, a director, doctoral and other students)
labs.join_notes: The home page advertises a Research Associate opening and a Postdoctoral Fellow opening, each with an apply link to Harvard's job systems. The Work With Us page gives contact@lish.harvard.edu for general questions and a form for research partnership proposals.
labs.notes: Karim R. Lakhani is listed in leadership as Founding Chair of the HBS AI Institute. Not counted: 16 listed LISH collaborators at other institutions and former staff. The cached institute-wide Our Team page lists the whole HBS AI Institute and was not used for the count.

notes: The LISH-specific team page was fetched (linked from the start page). The HBS AI Institute has nine other labs (Climate & Sustainability Impact Lab, Customer Intelligence Lab, Data Science and AI Operations Lab, Digital Emotions Lab, Digital Reskilling Lab, Platform Lab, Pricing Lab, Tech for All Lab, Trustworthy AI Lab); they are separate targets or outside this one and not recorded here.
